slides.title: Q3 Retention Review
slides.subtitle: Growth & Customer Success · Nov 2026
slides.hook: Churn dropped for the first time in four quarters.

slides.title: Retention stalled for three straight quarters
slides.hook: Before the fix, here's the problem we were solving.
bullets: Monthly churn held at 4.1-4.4% from Q4 to Q2
Mid-market accounts (50-200 seats) churned 2x faster than enterprise
Root cause: onboarding handoff between sales and CS had no owner

slides.title: Q3 in numbers
slides.takeaway: The onboarding fix mainly closed the mid-market gap - enterprise churn was already healthy.

left.title: What we changed
bullets: Named a single CS owner at handoff

right.title: What we're watching
bullets: Self-serve plan still has no owner

slides.title: Next: give self-serve the same fix
bullets: Assign an owner for self-serve onboarding by Nov 30
Re-measure mid-market churn in Q4 review
